sections.title: GM18 Named Product State
sections.text: Saves a named pose as a local attribute manifest (identity/revision, joints, parameters, visibility, fillState, springState, routeVariant, service disconnections). It is explicitly not a native Fusion ConfigurationTable. onExisting defaults to error; update requires confirm and bumps the revision.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, name, revision, manifest (schema fmcad.pose.manifest.v1), identity, changed. The manifest carries the eight state dimensions; fillState FULL/EMPTY changes the declared liquid state and springState COCKED the declared spring state; their mass/force effect is resolved by GM23/GM12, not recomputed here.

examples.label: Save a service pose
examples.requires: A selected component; root attributes available.
examples.output: result.name is Service, result.manifest.fillState is EMPTY and result.manifest.springState is COCKED.

verified: Local manifest is not a native ConfigurationTable
bugs: Native ConfigurationTable is deliberately not used; no native configuration feature is claimed

sections.title: GM18 Pose Application
sections.text: Applies a saved pose and leaves the requested state in place. Joints are driven through joint.drive, parameters through param.apply and visibility through the native light-bulb flag; fill/spring/route/service states are manifest-carried declarations. Incompatible documents and stale refs are rejected before mutation.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, name, revision, requested (the manifest), applied[], unapplied[], before, after, leftApplied:true. status is fail when any change is unapplied. apply never restores automatically.

examples.label: Apply the service pose
examples.requires: A saved pose named Service in the same document.
examples.output: result.leftApplied is true and result.unapplied lists dimensions that could not be applied.

verified: Stale refs and incompatible documents are rejected
joint.drive and param.apply are reused by dispatch
bugs: Fill/spring/route/service geometry is not synthesized here; downstream GM methods own that effect

sections.title: GM18 Pose Listing
sections.text: Enumerates saved poses with name, revision, savedAt and document identity from the local manifest index.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, poses[] and count; each pose row has name, revision, savedAt and document.

examples.label: List poses
examples.output: result.poses lists each saved pose by name.

sections.title: GM18 Pose Deletion
sections.text: Deletes a saved pose record from the local manifest. Requires confirm. No geometry is touched.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, name, deleted:true, revision.

examples.label: Delete the service pose
examples.output: result.deleted is true and the pose no longer appears in pose.list.

sections.title: GM18 Temporary Pose Evaluation
sections.text: Applies a pose temporarily, records before/after, then restores the previous state. Restoration failure is reported as a separate restoreErrors list and does not guarantee the previous state was re-established; the primary evaluation result is preserved.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, name, revision, requested, applied[], unapplied[], before, after, restored, restoration, restoreErrors[]. status is pass only when nothing is unapplied and restoration succeeded.

examples.label: Evaluate the service pose
examples.requires: A saved pose named Service in the same document.
examples.output: result.restored is true and result.restoreErrors is empty on success.

bugs: Restore is not a transaction rollback
